turns.speaker: Ada Park
turns.text: Hi everyone, I'm Ada. Thanks for joining the garden club call today.

turns.speaker: Ben Okafor
turns.text: Thanks, Ada. Happy to be here. I brought photos of my tomatoes.

turns.speaker: Ada Park
turns.text: Great. Ben, how did the balcony pots do this summer?

turns.speaker: Ben Okafor
turns.text: Much better than last year. Deep pots and less water made all the difference.

turns.speaker: Cleo Marsh
turns.text: Hi, I'm Cleo, sorry I'm late. My connection dropped.

turns.speaker: Ada Park
turns.text: No problem, Cleo. We were just talking about tomatoes.

turns.speaker: Cleo Marsh
turns.text: Mine grew in a bucket on the porch. Cherry tomatoes are easy.

turns.speaker: Ben Okafor
turns.text: That's what I keep telling people. Start small.

turns.speaker: Ada Park
turns.text: Let's see everyone for a moment. What about the herbs?

turns.speaker: Cleo Marsh
turns.text: Basil loves the heat. Mint takes over everything.

turns.speaker: Ben Okafor
turns.text: Mint is a weed with good manners.

turns.speaker: Ben Okafor
turns.text: Yes, in the sunniest corner. They need patience.

turns.speaker: Cleo Marsh
turns.text: Mine never turned red, only green.

turns.speaker: Ada Park
turns.text: Any last tips before we finish?

turns.speaker: Cleo Marsh
turns.text: Water in the morning, not at night.

turns.speaker: Ben Okafor
turns.text: And talk to your plants. They listen.

turns.speaker: Ada Park
turns.text: Thanks, Ben. Thanks, Cleo. See you next week.
